grades.quote: _i_ is a CSR instruction, and in the opcode of _i_ , _csr_ is set to _r_ , unless _i_ is CSRRS or CSRRC and _rs1_ is set to `x0` or _i_ is CSRRSI or CSRRCI and uimm[4:0] is set to zero.
grades.reason: For RVWMO dependency tracking, CSRRS counts the CSR as a destination register unless rs1 is the register x0. The rule is keyed to naming x0, not to the value in rs1, so a different register holding zero still counts as a destination. It covers dependency tracking only, not the architectural write semantics, so it answers only part of the question.
